title: Root-inspired grafting of wood surfaces with hyperbranched polymers for enhanced interfacial adhesion with impregnated decorative paper
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38706-38720
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07688E, Paper
Open Access

Hui Li, Ru Liu, Xinyu Li, Kun Xu, Jinzhen Cao
A root-like waterborne hyperbranched polymer, synthesized from diethylenetriamine (DETA) and methyl acrylate (MA) monomers, was inspired by the effect of solidifying soil with tree roots.
